title: College Football
description:
Michigan State at Wisconsin
Michigan State (2-2) faces Wisconsin (3-1) in Big Ten play in Week 5. Eighth-place Wisconsin beat Penn State 24-20 as Colton Joseph hit Jacob Harris on a 72-yard touchdown pass, while 16th-place Michigan State fell 31-13 to Nebraska in Week 4.

title: B1G  Football Game Break
description: Our analysts check in on the action all across the B1G as football Saturday continues.

title: College Football
description:
Purdue at Illinois
The Purdue Boilermakers visit the Illinois Fighting Illini in a Big Ten matchup at Gies Memorial Stadium. Purdue lost against Notre Dame, 49-10, and hopes to break a three-game skid, while Illinois lost to Ohio State, 42-19, in Week 4.

title: B1G  Football Game Break

title: College Football
description:
Indiana at Rutgers
The No. 6 Indiana Hoosiers play the Rutgers Scarlet Knights at SHI Stadium in a Big Ten game. Indiana enters with a perfect record, and defeated Northwestern, 29-23. Rutgers broke a three-game skid and won against Howard, 58-7, in their fourth week.
